evidence.summary: Baseline loadProjects cleared the status and list, then awaited fetch/json without loading, success, empty or error feedback. Caller catch handlers silently discarded failures.

findings.why_it_matters: A delayed, empty or failed read was indistinguishable from a blank list.
findings.proposed_change: Use region-local loading text and aria-busy, real loaded counts, an explicit empty state and recoverable local error messages.
findings.regression_risk: Preserve the read-only endpoint and real returned data; repeat pending, empty and retry behavior after changes.

evidence.summary: Baseline iterated response.json() without checking response.ok or validating an array of strings; an HTTP failure body could render as success and mixed arrays could render partial data.

findings.why_it_matters: The screen could misrepresent failed or malformed responses as valid projects.
findings.proposed_change: Require an OK HTTP response and an entire string array before rendering; retain textContent so markup remains literal data.
findings.regression_risk: Validation assumes the documented array-of-strings contract. A contract change requires revisiting both validation and tests.

evidence.summary: Baseline had no cancellation or request identity guard; separate submissions could complete in reverse order and overwrite the latest choice.

findings.why_it_matters: Users changing a test response during a wait could see outdated results.
findings.proposed_change: Abort the previous GET and ignore success/error/finally mutations from obsolete request versions.
findings.regression_risk: Keep the latest selected read authoritative even when an obsolete request ignores cancellation.

evidence.summary: Baseline supplied a permanently hidden Retry button with no listener in app.mjs, and status/list markup did not express atomic updates or the list busy state.

findings.why_it_matters: Failed reads had no recovery action; hiding a focused Retry control during recovery also needs a visible focus destination.
findings.proposed_change: Wire Retry to the failed scenario, return its focus to Load projects before hiding it, and add atomic status and list busy semantics.
findings.regression_risk: Keep focus on a visible control when Retry hides. Screen-reader behavior has not been tested.

evidence.summary: Baseline main used width:960px plus 72px horizontal padding with default content-box sizing, and its form was a single nonwrapping flex row.

findings.why_it_matters: The declared main box exceeded both 390px and 768px viewports before margins; long returned names had no explicit wrap strategy.
findings.proposed_change: Use border-box sizing, a fluid capped main width, one-column controls below 600px, long-name wrapping, 44px minimum controls and explicit focus-visible styles.
findings.regression_risk: Long content and other device/browser combinations can wrap differently; only the recorded three widths were verified.

findings.why_it_matters: This conflicts with the owner-supplied strict default for full-page canvas color.
findings.proposed_change: Use a considered tinted neutral canvas and a slightly lighter neutral main surface, preserving readable contrast.
findings.regression_risk: Surface changes can affect contrast; the recorded computed colors were checked in Chrome only.

findings.why_it_matters: The large floating shadow is a template-style treatment under the supplied policy.
findings.proposed_change: Remove the shadow and use restrained surface separation and a border.
findings.regression_risk: Keep grouping and control boundaries visible without relying on the removed shadow.

evidence.summary: Baseline selected Inter,sans-serif without providing a font resource.

findings.why_it_matters: The stack used the policy-banned automatic default and relied on an unspecified fallback.
findings.proposed_change: Use a considered local system font stack with no external font or dependency.
findings.regression_risk: System fonts vary across operating systems; typography and wrapping outside the recorded browser remain unverified.

evidence.summary: Baseline main used border-radius:32px on the single application container.

findings.why_it_matters: The oversized soft container conflicts with the supplied practical shape default.
findings.proposed_change: Use a controlled 4px radius for the main container and native controls.
findings.regression_risk: Keep controls and content unclipped when shape or spacing tokens change.

limitations: One synthetic native-web repair, with simulated response conditions. No production backend, React/Next.js runtime, other agent host, screen reader, full WCAG audit or controlled aesthetic comparison. Original agent skipped checks remain historical in agent/report.json.
The original source-only findings and limitations remain unchanged in agent/report.json; this file records the later root verification.
